name: Resume Builder Platform
value: Reduced resume customization time by turning repeated edits into reusable templates.
summary: A print-first resume website with API-driven content sections and controlled A4 export behavior.
challenge: The team needed a reusable resume delivery format that stayed readable both online and in printed PDF without repetitive manual edits.
solution: Built a structured section model with API-driven content, print-aware layout constraints, and section-level formatting controls.
impact: Reduced resume update overhead and made each tailored version faster to generate.

name: Admin Workflow Dashboard
value: Improved operator visibility by consolidating task queues and status into one timeline view.
summary: Dashboard experience with role-based workflows, reusable widgets, and clearer task lifecycle tracking.
challenge: Operators had to switch across multiple pages to understand task states and next actions, causing delays and context loss.
solution: Designed a unified dashboard with grouped statuses, timeline visualization, and reusable widgets connected to role-specific permissions.
impact: Improved operational clarity and shortened the time needed to complete routine workflows.

name: Brand Website Revamp
value: Boosted loading performance with static generation and smarter content rendering.
summary: Marketing site architecture focused on SEO structure, content maintainability, and delivery speed.
challenge: The previous site had weak performance and inconsistent page structure, hurting discoverability and editorial speed.
solution: Rebuilt the marketing stack with static generation, improved semantic structure, and maintainable content blocks.
impact: Delivered faster pages and a cleaner publishing workflow for ongoing content updates.
